{"timestamp":"2026-10-16T08:06:11.129Z","ordinal":5,"type":"response_item","payload":{"type":"message","id":"msg_01a143bf-45b8-75b3-8eb2-815f8f0bdb45","role":"user","content":[{"type":"input_text","text":"# AGENTS.md instructions for D:\\HCUP\\vg-spec13\n\n<INSTRUCTIONS>\n# HarmonyOS NEXT 开发核心规则与最佳实践\r\n\r\n本文档基于 Huawei 开发者官方文档及社区最佳实践整理，适用于 HarmonyOS NEXT (API 12+) 开发。\r\n\r\n## 1. ArkTS 语言规范 (强制)\r\n\r\nArkTS 是 HarmonyOS NEXT 的主力开发语言，基于 TypeScript 扩展，但在运行时有更严格的限制以提升性能。\r\n\r\n### 1.1 严格类型安全\r\n- **禁止使用 `any` 和 `unknown`**：必须显式声明变量和函数返回值的类型。\r\n- **禁止运行时动态特性**：不支持动态添加属性、删除属性等 JS 动态操作。\r\n- **空安全**：启用严格空检查 (`strictNullChecks`)，并在代码中显式处理 `null` 和 `undefined`。\r\n- **ESObject**：仅在与 JS 库交互或跨语言调用时使用 `ESObject`，并在使用完毕后尽快转换为具体的 ArkTS 类型。\r\n\r\n### 1.2 语法限制\r\n- **类定义**：必须在声明时初始化字段，或在构造函数中初始化。\r\n- **模块化**：使用 ES6 模块标准 (`import`/`export`)，禁止使用 CommonJS (`require`).\r\n- **并发模型**：ArkTS 采用 Actor 模型，内存隔离。线程间通信需通过 `TaskPool` 或 `Worker`，数据传递通常是深拷贝或 Transferable 对象。\r\n\r\n## 2. ArkUI 开发规范\r\n\r\n### 2.1 组件化设计\r\n- **`@Component`**：UI 组件必须使用 `@Component` 装饰。\r\n- **`@Entry`**：页面入口组件使用 `@Entry` 装饰。\r\n- **`@Builder` / `@BuilderParam`**：轻量级 UI 复用，优先于自定义组件，减少组件实例开销。\r\n- **组件拆分**：将复杂页面拆分为多个子组件，保持代码清晰，每个组件文件不超过 500 行。\r\n\r\n### 2.2 状态管理\r\n- **原则**：最小化状态共享范围，避免全局状态滥用。\r\n- **装饰器选择**：\r\n  - `@State`：组件内部私有状态。\r\n  - `@Prop`：父子单向同步（父 -> 子）。\r\n  - `@Link`：父子双向同步（父 <-> 子）。\r\n  - `@Provide`/`@Consume`：跨组件层级同步。\r\n  - `AppStorage`/`LocalStorage`：全局或页面级状态共享。\r\n- **更新机制**：状态变量必须通过赋值更新，不要直接修改对象属性（除非使用 `@Observed` 和 `@ObjectLink` 处理嵌套对象）。\r\n\r\n### 2.3 布局与样式\r\n- **单位**：统一使用 `vp` (虚拟像素) 和 `fp` (字体像素)，禁止硬编码 `px`。\r\n- **布局性能**：\r\n  - 减少布局嵌套层级（特别是 `Stack` 和 `Flex` 的深层嵌套）。\r\n  - 优先使用 `RelativeContainer` 替代复杂的嵌套布局。\r\n  - 列表渲染必须使用 `LazyForEach`，并提供唯一的 `keyGenerator`，避免全量重绘。\r\n- **自适应**：使用断点 (`GridRow`/`GridCol`) 和媒体查询适配多设备屏幕。\r\n\r\n## 3. 性能优化指南\r\n\r\n### 3.1 渲染性能\r\n- **LazyForEach**：长列表数据必须使用 `LazyForEach` 加载，配合 `cachedCount` 预加载。\r\n- **条件渲染**：频繁切换显隐建议使用 `visibility` 属性控制，而非 `if/else`（后者会触发生命周期）。\r\n- **图片优化**：加载大图时使用 `Image` 组件的 `sourceSize` 属性进行解码尺寸裁剪，避免内存浪费。\r\n\r\n### 3.2 并发与异步\r\n- **主线程减负**：耗时操作（IO、复杂计算、网络请求）必须移至后台线程。\r\n- **TaskPool**：优先使用 `TaskPool` 处理短时任务，系统会自动管理线程生命周期。\r\n- **Worker**：适用于长时间运行的后台任务。\r\n- **Promise**：异步操作统一使用 Promise 或 async/await，避免回调地狱。\r\n\r\n### 3.3 内存管理\r\n- **资源释放**：组件销毁时 (`aboutToDisappear`) 及时注销事件监听、定时器和后台任务。\r\n- **上下文泄漏**：避免在长生命周期对象中持有 AbilityContext 或 UI 组件引用。\r\n\r\n## 4. 项目架构与工程规范\r\n\r\n### 4.1 目录结构\r\n```text\r\nentry/src/main/ets/\r\n├── pages/          # 页面入口 (@Entry)\r\n├── components/     # 公共 UI 组件\r\n├── model/          # 数据模型 (Class/Interface)\r\n├── utils/          # 工具类\r\n├── service/        # 业务逻辑服务 (API, Database)\r\n├── common/         # 全局常量、枚举\r\n└── resources/      # 静态资源\r\n```\r\n\r\n### 4.2 命名规范\r\n- **类/接口/组件**：PascalCase (e.g., `UserComponent`, `DataService`)\r\n- **变量/函数/方法**：camelCase (e.g., `fetchUserData`, `isOpen`)\r\n- **常量/枚举值**：UPPER_SNAKE_CASE (e.g., `MAX_RETRY_COUNT`)\r\n- **文件命名**：与主要导出内容一致，组件文件通常 PascalCase，工具文件 camelCase。\r\n\r\n### 4.3 Kit 使用\r\n- 优先使用 HarmonyOS 内置 Kit (如 `ArkData` 用于数据库, `NetworkKit` 用于网络, `ArkUI` 用于界面)。\r\n- 引入第三方库前需确认其是否支持 HarmonyOS NEXT (ArkTS 兼容性)。\r\n\r\n## 5. 安全与隐私\r\n\r\n- **权限最小化**：仅申请业务必须的权限 (`module.json5`)。\r\n- **用户授权**：运行时敏感权限必须向用户动态申请。\r\n- **数据安全**：\r\n  - 敏感数据（Token、密码）存储使用 `WebDavCrypto` 或系统级 `KeyStore`。\r\n  - 本地数据库优先使用 `RdbStore` 或 `Preferences` 并加密。\r\n\r\n---\r\n\r\n# 本题自动调度\r\n\r\n题号：vg-spec13\r\n\r\n本题根目录：D:/HCUP/vg-spec13\r\n\r\n主 Agent 开始/继续作答时加载 `D:/HarmonyDev/codex/skills/harmony-task-flow/SKILL.md`，读取 workflow/state.json，调度四个角色并按失败证据回退。\r\n\r\n子 Agent 仅完成收到的派工，不自行成为调度者或创建子 Agent。仅使用本题 inputs、project 和记录；禁止其他题工程及相关上游修复历史。\r\n\r\n## HCUP 工作区布局与阶段\r\n\r\n本题工程根就是当前目录；workflow/state.json 的 project 指向当前目录，不要再创建 project 子目录，也不要使用 Skill 示例中的另一套工程路径。\r\n\r\n本题需求读取 spec/requirement.md，元数据读取 spec/metadata.json；inputs/ 保留原始输入副本。公共资源只读访问 ../common/，不得访问其他赛题目录。\r\n\r\n开始构建或设备命令前加载 D:/HCUP/.hcup-local/Enter-HarmonyEnv.ps1。\r\n\r\n本次仅完成独立工程准备；尚未分析需求、设计方案或实现功能。正式作答从本目录的新会话开始，登记新会话后再按四角色流程推进。\r\n\r\n初始化总览会话也包含公共环境、官方示例与其他题的工程准备内容，不能将其视为本题功能开发证据；后续需求和编码角色不要读取该总览会话作为实现参考。\r\n\n</INSTRUCTIONS>"},{"type":"input_text","text":"<environment_context>\n  <cwd>D:\\HCUP\\vg-spec13</cwd>\n  <shell>powershell</shell>\n  <current_date>2026-10-16</current_date>\n  <timezone>Asia/Shanghai</timezone>\n  <filesystem><workspace_roots><root>D:\\HCUP\\vg-spec13</root><root>C:\\Users\\22580\\.codex\\visualizations\\2026\\10\\16\\01a143b8-b8fa-7491-a22c-c0e5faed0de0</root></workspace_roots><permission_profile type=\"disabled\"><file_system type=\"unrestricted\" /></permission_profile></filesystem>\n</environment_context>"}],"internal_chat_message_metadata_passthrough":{"turn_id":"01a143bf-41b4-7fc1-ad9e-48cc9b3becef","create_time":1792137971.1288743,"content_item_kinds":["agents_md.instructions","environments.environment_context"]}}}

ArkTS 语言规范 (强制)\r\n\r\nArkTS 是 HarmonyOS NEXT 的主力开发语言，基于 TypeScript 扩展，但在运行时有更严格的限制以提升性能。\r\n\r\n### 1.1 严格类型安全\r\n- **禁止使用 `any` 和 `unknown`**：必须显式声明变量和函数返回值的类型。\r\n- **禁止运行时动态特性**：不支持动态添加属性、删除属性等 JS 动态操作。\r\n- **空安全**：启用严格空检查 (`strictNullChecks`)，并在代码中显式处理 `null` 和 `undefined`。\r\n- **ESObject**：仅在与 JS 库交互或跨语言调用时使用 `ESObject`，并在使用完毕后尽快转换为具体的 ArkTS 类型。\r\n\r\n### 1.2 语法限制\r\n- **类定义**：必须在声明时初始化字段，或在构造函数中初始化。\r\n- **模块化**：使用 ES6 模块标准 (`import`/`export`)，禁止使用 CommonJS (`require`).\r\n- **并发模型**：ArkTS 采用 Actor 模型，内存隔离。线程间通信需通过 `TaskPool` 或 `Worker`，数据传递通常是深拷贝或 Transferable 对象。\r\n\r\n## 2. ArkUI 开发规范\r\n\r\n### 2.1 组件化设计\r\n- **`@Component`**：UI 组件必须使用 `@Component` 装饰。\r\n- **`@Entry`**：页面入口组件使用 `@Entry` 装饰。\r\n- **`@Builder` / `@BuilderParam`**：轻量级 UI 复用，优先于自定义组件，减少组件实例开销。\r\n- **组件拆分**：将复杂页面拆分为多个子组件，保持代码清晰，每个组件文件不超过 500 行。\r\n\r\n### 2.2 状态管理\r\n- **原则**：最小化状态共享范围，避免全局状态滥用。\r\n- **装饰器选择**：\r\n  - `@State`：组件内部私有状态。\r\n  - `@Prop`：父子单向同步（父 -> 子）。\r\n  - `@Link`：父子双向同步（父 <-> 子）。\r\n  - `@Provide`/`@Consume`：跨组件层级同步。\r\n  - `AppStorage`/`LocalStorage`：全局或页面级状态共享。\r\n- **更新机制**：状态变量必须通过赋值更新，不要直接修改对象属性（除非使用 `@Observed` 和 `@ObjectLink` 处理嵌套对象）。\r\n\r\n### 2.3 布局与样式\r\n- **单位**：统一使用 `vp` (虚拟像素) 和 `fp` (字体像素)，禁止硬编码 `px`。\r\n- **布局性能**：\r\n  - 减少布局嵌套层级（特别是 `Stack` 和 `Flex` 的深层嵌套）。\r\n  - 优先使用 `RelativeContainer` 替代复杂的嵌套布局。\r\n  - 列表渲染必须使用 `LazyForEach`，并提供唯一的 `keyGenerator`，避免全量重绘。\r\n- **自适应**：使用断点 (`GridRow`/`GridCol`) 和媒体查询适配多设备屏幕。\r\n\r\n## 3. 性能优化指南\r\n\r\n### 3.1 渲染性能\r\n- **LazyForEach**：长列表数据必须使用 `LazyForEach` 加载，配合 `cachedCount` 预加载。\r\n- **条件渲染**：频繁切换显隐建议使用 `visibility` 属性控制，而非 `if/else`（后者会触发生命周期）。\r\n- **图片优化**：加载大图时使用 `Image` 组件的 `sourceSize` 属性进行解码尺寸裁剪，避免内存浪费。\r\n\r\n### 3.2 并发与异步\r\n- **主线程减负**：耗时操作（IO、复杂计算、网络请求）必须移至后台线程。\r\n- **TaskPool**：优先使用 `TaskPool` 处理短时任务，系统会自动管理线程生命周期。\r\n- **Worker**：适用于长时间运行的后台任务。\r\n- **Promise**：异步操作统一使用 Promise 或 async/await，避免回调地狱。\r\n\r\n### 3.3 内存管理\r\n- **资源释放**：组件销毁时 (`aboutToDisappear`) 及时注销事件监听、定时器和后台任务。\r\n- **上下文泄漏**：避免在长生命周期对象中持有 AbilityContext 或 UI 组件引用。\r\n\r\n## 4. 项目架构与工程规范\r\n\r\n### 4.1 目录结构\r\n```text\r\nentry/src/main/ets/\r\n├── pages/          # 页面入口 (@Entry)\r\n├── components/     # 公共 UI 组件\r\n├── model/          # 数据模型 (Class/Interface)\r\n├── utils/          # 工具类\r\n├── service/        # 业务逻辑服务 (API, Database)\r\n├── common/         # 全局常量、枚举\r\n└── resources/      # 静态资源\r\n```\r\n\r\n### 4.2 命名规范\r\n- **类/接口/组件**：PascalCase (e.g., `UserComponent`, `DataService`)\r\n- **变量/函数/方法**：camelCase (e.g., `fetchUserData`, `isOpen`)\r\n- **常量/枚举值**：UPPER_SNAKE_CASE (e.g., `MAX_RETRY_COUNT`)\r\n- **文件命名**：与主要导出内容一致，组件文件通常 PascalCase，工具文件 camelCase。\r\n\r\n### 4.3 Kit 使用\r\n- 优先使用 HarmonyOS 内置 Kit (如 `ArkData` 用于数据库, `NetworkKit` 用于网络, `ArkUI` 用于界面)。\r\n- 引入第三方库前需确认其是否支持 HarmonyOS NEXT (ArkTS 兼容性)。\r\n\r\n## 5. 安全与隐私\r\n\r\n- **权限最小化**：仅申请业务必须的权限 (`module.json5`)。\r\n- **用户授权**：运行时敏感权限必须向用户动态申请。\r\n- **数据安全**：\r\n  - 敏感数据（Token、密码）存储使用 `WebDavCrypto` 或系统级 `KeyStore`。\r\n  - 本地数据库优先使用 `RdbStore` 或 `Preferences` 并加密。\r\n\r\n---\r\n\r\n# 本题自动调度\r\n\r\n题号：vg-spec13\r\n\r\n本题根目录：D:/HCUP/vg-spec13\r\n\r\n主 Agent 开始/继续作答时加载 `D:/HarmonyDev/codex/skills/harmony-task-flow/SKILL.md`，读取 workflow/state.json，调度四个角色并按失败证据回退。\r\n\r\n子 Agent 仅完成收到的派工，不自行成为调度者或创建子 Agent。仅使用本题 inputs、project 和记录；禁止其他题工程及相关上游修复历史。\r\n\r\n## HCUP 工作区布局与阶段\r\n\r\n本题工程根就是当前目录；workflow/state.json 的 project 指向当前目录，不要再创建 project 子目录，也不要使用 Skill 示例中的另一套工程路径。\r\n\r\n本题需求读取 spec/requirement.md，元数据读取 spec/metadata.json；inputs/ 保留原始输入副本。公共资源只读访问 ../common/，不得访问其他赛题目录。\r\n\r\n开始构建或设备命令前加载 D:/HCUP/.hcup-local/Enter-HarmonyEnv.ps1。\r\n\r\n本次仅完成独立工程准备；尚未分析需求、设计方案或实现功能。正式作答从本目录的新会话开始，登记新会话后再按四角色流程推进。\r\n\r\n初始化总览会话也包含公共环境、官方示例与其他题的工程准备内容，不能将其视为本题功能开发证据；后续需求和编码角色不要读取该总览会话作为实现参考。\r\n"},"apps_instructions":false,"collaboration_mode":{"mode":"default","model":"gpt-6.1-sol","instructions":"0a11049b0421e1e86f1e129af8d547a89548a0c3"},"context_window_guidance":"","environments":{"environments":{"local":{"cwd":"D:\\HCUP\\vg-spec13","status":"available","shell":"powershell"}},"current_date":"2026-10-16","timezone":"Asia/Shanghai","filesystem":"<filesystem><workspace_roots><root>D:\\HCUP\\vg-spec13</root><root>C:\\Users\\22580\\.codex\\visualizations\\2026\\10\\16\\01a143b8-b8fa-7491-a22c-c0e5faed0de0</root></workspace_roots><permission_profile type=\"disabled\"><file_system type=\"unrestricted\" /></permission_profile></filesystem>"},"environments_instructions":false,"git_attribution":false,"host_skills":{"body":"\n## Skills\nA skill is a set of local instructions to follow that is stored in a `SKILL.md` file. ArkTS 语言规范 (强制)\r\n\r\nArkTS 是 HarmonyOS NEXT 的主力开发语言，基于 TypeScript 扩展，但在运行时有更严格的限制以提升性能。\r\n\r\n### 1.1 严格类型安全\r\n- **禁止使用 `any` 和 `unknown`**：必须显式声明变量和函数返回值的类型。\r\n- **禁止运行时动态特性**：不支持动态添加属性、删除属性等 JS 动态操作。\r\n- **空安全**：启用严格空检查 (`strictNullChecks`)，并在代码中显式处理 `null` 和 `undefined`。\r\n- **ESObject**：仅在与 JS 库交互或跨语言调用时使用 `ESObject`，并在使用完毕后尽快转换为具体的 ArkTS 类型。\r\n\r\n### 1.2 语法限制\r\n- **类定义**：必须在声明时初始化字段，或在构造函数中初始化。\r\n- **模块化**：使用 ES6 模块标准 (`import`/`export`)，禁止使用 CommonJS (`require`).\r\n- **并发模型**：ArkTS 采用 Actor 模型，内存隔离。线程间通信需通过 `TaskPool` 或 `Worker`，数据传递通常是深拷贝或 Transferable 对象。\r\n\r\n## 2. ArkUI 开发规范\r\n\r\n### 2.1 组件化设计\r\n- **`@Component`**：UI 组件必须使用 `@Component` 装饰。\r\n- **`@Entry`**：页面入口组件使用 `@Entry` 装饰。\r\n- **`@Builder` / `@BuilderParam`**：轻量级 UI 复用，优先于自定义组件，减少组件实例开销。\r\n- **组件拆分**：将复杂页面拆分为多个子组件，保持代码清晰，每个组件文件不超过 500 行。\r\n\r\n### 2.2 状态管理\r\n- **原则**：最小化状态共享范围，避免全局状态滥用。\r\n- **装饰器选择**：\r\n  - `@State`：组件内部私有状态。\r\n  - `@Prop`：父子单向同步（父 -> 子）。\r\n  - `@Link`：父子双向同步（父 <-> 子）。\r\n  - `@Provide`/`@Consume`：跨组件层级同步。\r\n  - `AppStorage`/`LocalStorage`：全局或页面级状态共享。\r\n- **更新机制**：状态变量必须通过赋值更新，不要直接修改对象属性（除非使用 `@Observed` 和 `@ObjectLink` 处理嵌套对象）。\r\n\r\n### 2.3 布局与样式\r\n- **单位**：统一使用 `vp` (虚拟像素) 和 `fp` (字体像素)，禁止硬编码 `px`。\r\n- **布局性能**：\r\n  - 减少布局嵌套层级（特别是 `Stack` 和 `Flex` 的深层嵌套）。\r\n  - 优先使用 `RelativeContainer` 替代复杂的嵌套布局。\r\n  - 列表渲染必须使用 `LazyForEach`，并提供唯一的 `keyGenerator`，避免全量重绘。\r\n- **自适应**：使用断点 (`GridRow`/`GridCol`) 和媒体查询适配多设备屏幕。\r\n\r\n## 3. 性能优化指南\r\n\r\n### 3.1 渲染性能\r\n- **LazyForEach**：长列表数据必须使用 `LazyForEach` 加载，配合 `cachedCount` 预加载。\r\n- **条件渲染**：频繁切换显隐建议使用 `visibility` 属性控制，而非 `if/else`（后者会触发生命周期）。\r\n- **图片优化**：加载大图时使用 `Image` 组件的 `sourceSize` 属性进行解码尺寸裁剪，避免内存浪费。\r\n\r\n### 3.2 并发与异步\r\n- **主线程减负**：耗时操作（IO、复杂计算、网络请求）必须移至后台线程。\r\n- **TaskPool**：优先使用 `TaskPool` 处理短时任务，系统会自动管理线程生命周期。\r\n- **Worker**：适用于长时间运行的后台任务。\r\n- **Promise**：异步操作统一使用 Promise 或 async/await，避免回调地狱。\r\n\r\n### 3.3 内存管理\r\n- **资源释放**：组件销毁时 (`aboutToDisappear`) 及时注销事件监听、定时器和后台任务。\r\n- **上下文泄漏**：避免在长生命周期对象中持有 AbilityContext 或 UI 组件引用。\r\n\r\n## 4. 项目架构与工程规范\r\n\r\n### 4.1 目录结构\r\n```text\r\nentry/src/main/ets/\r\n├── pages/          # 页面入口 (@Entry)\r\n├── components/     # 公共 UI 组件\r\n├── model/          # 数据模型 (Class/Interface)\r\n├── utils/          # 工具类\r\n├── service/        # 业务逻辑服务 (API, Database)\r\n├── common/         # 全局常量、枚举\r\n└── resources/      # 静态资源\r\n```\r\n\r\n### 4.2 命名规范\r\n- **类/接口/组件**：PascalCase (e.g., `UserComponent`, `DataService`)\r\n- **变量/函数/方法**：camelCase (e.g., `fetchUserData`, `isOpen`)\r\n- **常量/枚举值**：UPPER_SNAKE_CASE (e.g., `MAX_RETRY_COUNT`)\r\n- **文件命名**：与主要导出内容一致，组件文件通常 PascalCase，工具文件 camelCase。\r\n\r\n### 4.3 Kit 使用\r\n- 优先使用 HarmonyOS 内置 Kit (如 `ArkData` 用于数据库, `NetworkKit` 用于网络, `ArkUI` 用于界面)。\r\n- 引入第三方库前需确认其是否支持 HarmonyOS NEXT (ArkTS 兼容性)。\r\n\r\n## 5. 安全与隐私\r\n\r\n- **权限最小化**：仅申请业务必须的权限 (`module.json5`)。\r\n- **用户授权**：运行时敏感权限必须向用户动态申请。\r\n- **数据安全**：\r\n  - 敏感数据（Token、密码）存储使用 `WebDavCrypto` 或系统级 `KeyStore`。\r\n  - 本地数据库优先使用 `RdbStore` 或 `Preferences` 并加密。\r\n\r\n---\r\n\r\n# 本题自动调度\r\n\r\n题号：vg-spec13\r\n\r\n本题根目录：D:/HCUP/vg-spec13\r\n\r\n主 Agent 备份进度提示与实际操作保持一致\r\n\r\n## 场景一：手动备份显示加载指示器\r\n\r\n### 场景概述\r\n\r\n用户点击「立即备份」后，WebDAV 配置页必须在备份操作仍在运行时渲染 ArkUI `LoadingProgress` 加载指示器。\r\n\r\n### 操作步骤与预期结果\r\n\r\n1. 用户进入 WebDAV 配置页，并填写可访问的 WebDAV 配置。\r\n2. 用户点击「立即备份」按钮。\r\n3. 页面进入备份忙碌状态。\r\n4. 页面显示 ArkUI `LoadingProgress` 加载指示器。\r\n\r\n## 场景二：手动备份显示忙碌文案\r\n\r\n### 场景概述\r\n\r\n备份期间，页面必须展示「正在...」或「处理中...」一类的状态提示文字，让用户能够区分正在工作和空闲状态。\r\n\r\n### 操作步骤与预期结果\r\n\r\n1. 用户点击「立即备份」。\r\n2. 页面进入备份忙碌状态。\r\n3. 页面显示操作进行中的状态提示。\r\n4. 该文案在备份操作进行期间可见。\r\n\r\n## 场景三：手动备份向 WebDAV 服务端发送请求\r\n\r\n### 场景概述\r\n\r\n加载状态必须绑定真实的 WebDAV 操作。备份流程在忙碌状态可见时，必须向配置的 WebDAV 端点发送请求。\r\n\r\n### 操作步骤与预期结果\r\n\r\n1. 用户点击「立即备份」。\r\n2. 页面显示备份加载状态。\r\n3. 应用向配置的 WebDAV 服务端发送请求。\r\n4. 如果只出现加载状态而没有 WebDAV 请求，则该功能点不满足要求。\r\n# vg-spec13 验收矩阵（仅分析）\r\n\r\n## 1. 范围、快照与证据规则\r\n\r\n- It builds\r\nupon TypeScript with enhanced static typing to improve program stability and\r\nperformance.\r\n\r\n## Core Features\r\n\r\n- **Static Typing**: All types determined at compile time, reducing runtime checks\r\n- **No Dynamic Object Layout**: Object structure fixed at compile time, cannot be\r\n  modified at runtime\r\n- **Restricted Operators**: Some operator behaviors are restricted to encourage\r\n  clearer code semantics\r\n- **No Structural Typing**: Structural typing is currently not supported\r\n\r\n## Reference Documentation\r\n\r\n| Scenario | Document |\r\n|----------|----------|\r\n| Syntax Learning | [references/en/introduction-to-arkts.md](references/en/introduction-to-arkts.md) |\r\n| Quick Overview | [references/en/arkts-get-started.md](references/en/arkts-get-started.md) |\r\n| TS Migration | [references/en/typescript-to-arkts-migration-guide.md](references/en/typescript-to-arkts-migration-guide.md) |\r\n| Migration Background | [references/en/arkts-migration-background.md](references/en/arkts-migration-background.md) |\r\n| Performance | [references/en/arkts-high-performance-programming.md](references/en/arkts-high-performance-programming.md) |\r\n| More Cases | [references/en/arkts-more-cases.md](references/en/arkts-more-cases.md) |\r\n\r\n## Workflows\r\n\r\n### 1. Syntax Questions\r\n\r\n```\r\nUser Question -> Identify Question Type -> Consult Documentation -> Provide Code Example\r\n```\r\n\r\n**Common Syntax Questions**:\r\n- Variable declaration -> Use `let`/`const` with explicit type or inference\r\n- Function definition -> Supports optional parameters, defaults, rest parameters,\r\n  arrow functions\r\n- Classes and interfaces -> Must initialize fields, supports inheritance and\r\n  implementation\r\n- Generics -> Supports constraints and default values\r\n- Null safety -> Nullable types ((T | null)), non-null assertion ((!)), optional\r\n  chaining ((?.))\r\n\r\n### 2. TypeScript Migration\r\n\r\n```\r\nIdentify TS Code -> Check Incompatible Features -> Consult Migration Rules -> Provide ArkTS Alternative\r\n```\r\n\r\n**Key Migration Rules Quick Reference**:\r\n\r\n| TypeScript | ArkTS Alternative |\r\n|------------|-------------------|\r\n| `var x` | `let x` |\r\n| `any`/`unknown` | Specific types |\r\n| `{n: 42}` object literal | Define class/interface first |\r\n| `[index: T]: U` index signature | `Record<T, U>` |\r\n| `A & B` intersection type | `interface C extends A, B` |\r\n| `function(){}` function expression | `() => {}` arrow function |\r\n| `<Type>value` type assertion | `value as Type` |\r\n| Destructuring `[a, b] = arr` | Individual access `arr[0]`, `arr[1]` |\r\n| `for..in` | `for` loop or `for..of` |\r\n| Constructor parameter properties | Explicit field declaration |\r\n\r\n### 3. Performance Optimization\r\n\r\n```\r\nAnalyze Code -> Identify Performance Issues -> Consult Optimization Guide -> Provide Solutions\r\n```\r\n\r\n**High-Performance Programming Key Points**:\r\n\r\n- **Declarations**: Use `const` for invariants; avoid mixing integer and float\r\n- **Loops**: Extract loop invariants; avoid numeric overflow\r\n- **Functions**: Parameter passing preferred over closures; avoid optional\r\n  parameters\r\n- **Arrays**: Use TypedArray for numeric values; avoid sparse arrays and union\r\n  type arrays\r\n- **Exceptions**: Avoid throwing in loops; use return values instead\r\n\r\n### 4. Compile Error Resolution\r\n\r\n```\r\nGet Error Message -> Search Migration Rules -> Find Related Case -> Provide Fix\r\n```\r\n\r\n## Common Questions\r\n\r\n### Q: How to handle JSON.parse return value?\r\n\r\n```typescript\r\n// Error\r\nlet data = JSON.parse(str);\r\n\r\n// Correct\r\nlet data: Record<string, Object> = JSON.parse(str);\r\n```\r\n\r\n### Q: How to define object types?\r\n\r\n```typescript\r\n// TypeScript syntax (not supported in ArkTS)\r\ntype Person = { name: string, age: number }\r\n\r\n// ArkTS syntax\r\ninterface Person {\r\n  name: string;\r\n  age: number;\r\n}\r\n\r\n// Using object literal\r\nlet p: Person = { name: 'John', age: 25 };\r\n```\r\n\r\n### Q: How to replace globalThis?\r\n\r\n```typescript\r\n// Error\r\nglobalThis.value = 'xxx';\r\n\r\n// Use singleton pattern\r\nexport class GlobalContext {\r\n  private constructor() {}\r\n  private static instance: GlobalContext;\r\n  private _objects = new Map<string, Object>();\r\n\r\n  public static getContext(): GlobalContext {\r\n    if (!GlobalContext.instance) {\r\n      GlobalContext.instance = new GlobalContext();\r\n    }\r\n    return GlobalContext.instance;\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  getObject(key: string): Object | undefined {\r\n    return this._objects.get(key);\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  setObject(key: string, value: Object): void {\r\n    this._objects.set(key, value);\r\n  }\r\n}\r\n```\r\n\r\n### Q: How to handle error types in catch?\r\n\r\n```typescript\r\n// Error\r\ntry {} catch (e: BusinessError) {}\r\n\r\n// Correct\r\ntry {} catch (error) {\r\n  let e: BusinessError = error as BusinessError;\r\n}\r\n```\r\n\r\n### Q: How to use Record type?\r\n\r\n```typescript\r\n// TypeScript index signature\r\nfunction foo(data: { [key: string]: string }) {}\r\n\r\n// ArkTS Record\r\nfunction foo(data: Record<string, string>) {}\r\n\r\n// Usage example\r\nlet map: Record<string, number> = {\r\n  'John': 25,\r\n  'Mary': 21,\r\n};\r\n```\r\n\r\n### Q: How to replace constructor signatures with factory functions?\r\n\r\n```typescript\r\n// TypeScript constructor signature\r\ntype ControllerCtor = {\r\n  new (value: string): Controller;\r\n}\r\n\r\n// ArkTS factory function\r\ntype ControllerFactory = () => Controller;\r\n\r\nclass Menu {\r\n  createController: ControllerFactory = () => {\r\n    return new Controller('default');\r\n  }\r\n}\r\n```\r\n\r\n## Prohibited Standard Library APIs\r\n\r\nThe following are prohibited in ArkTS:\r\n\r\n- **Global**: `eval`\r\n- **Object**: `__proto__`, ArkTS 语言规范 (强制)\\r\\n\\r\\nArkTS 是 HarmonyOS NEXT 的主力开发语言，基于 TypeScript 扩展，但在运行时有更严格的限制以提升性能。\\r\\n\\r\\n### 1.1 严格类型安全\\r\\n- **禁止使用 `any` 和 `unknown`**：必须显式声明变量和函数返回值的类型。\\r\\n- **禁止运行时动态特性**：不支持动态添加属性、删除属性等 JS 动态操作。\\r\\n- **空安全**：启用严格空检查 (`strictNullChecks`)，并在代码中显式处理 `null` 和 `undefined`。\\r\\n- **ESObject**：仅在与 JS 库交互或跨语言调用时使用 `ESObject`，并在使用完毕后尽快转换为具体的 ArkTS 类型。\\r\\n\\r\\n### 1.2 语法限制\\r\\n- **类定义**：必须在声明时初始化字段，或在构造函数中初始化。\\r\\n- **模块化**：使用 ES6 模块标准 (`import`/`export`)，禁止使用 CommonJS (`require`).\\r\\n- **并发模型**：ArkTS 采用 Actor 模型，内存隔离。线程间通信需通过 `TaskPool` 或 `Worker`，数据传递通常是深拷贝或 Transferable 对象。\\r\\n\\r\\n## 2. ArkUI 开发规范\\r\\n\\r\\n### 2.1 组件化设计\\r\\n- **`@Component`**：UI 组件必须使用 `@Component` 装饰。\\r\\n- **`@Entry`**：页面入口组件使用 `@Entry` 装饰。\\r\\n- **`@Builder` / `@BuilderParam`**：轻量级 UI 复用，优先于自定义组件，减少组件实例开销。\\r\\n- **组件拆分**：将复杂页面拆分为多个子组件，保持代码清晰，每个组件文件不超过 500 行。\\r\\n\\r\\n### 2.2 状态管理\\r\\n- **原则**：最小化状态共享范围，避免全局状态滥用。\\r\\n- **装饰器选择**：\\r\\n  - `@State`：组件内部私有状态。\\r\\n  - `@Prop`：父子单向同步（父 -> 子）。\\r\\n  - `@Link`：父子双向同步（父 <-> 子）。\\r\\n  - `@Provide`/`@Consume`：跨组件层级同步。\\r\\n  - `AppStorage`/`LocalStorage`：全局或页面级状态共享。\\r\\n- **更新机制**：状态变量必须通过赋值更新，不要直接修改对象属性（除非使用 `@Observed` 和 `@ObjectLink` 处理嵌套对象）。\\r\\n\\r\\n### 2.3 布局与样式\\r\\n- **单位**：统一使用 `vp` (虚拟像素) 和 `fp` (字体像素)，禁止硬编码 `px`。\\r\\n- **布局性能**：\\r\\n  - 减少布局嵌套层级（特别是 `Stack` 和 `Flex` 的深层嵌套）。\\r\\n  - 优先使用 `RelativeContainer` 替代复杂的嵌套布局。\\r\\n  - 列表渲染必须使用 `LazyForEach`，并提供唯一的 `keyGenerator`，避免全量重绘。\\r\\n- **自适应**：使用断点 (`GridRow`/`GridCol`) 和媒体查询适配多设备屏幕。\\r\\n\\r\\n## 3. 性能优化指南\\r\\n\\r\\n### 3.1 渲染性能\\r\\n- **LazyForEach**：长列表数据必须使用 `LazyForEach` 加载，配合 `cachedCount` 预加载。\\r\\n- **条件渲染**：频繁切换显隐建议使用 `visibility` 属性控制，而非 `if/else`（后者会触发生命周期）。\\r\\n- **图片优化**：加载大图时使用 `Image` 组件的 `sourceSize` 属性进行解码尺寸裁剪，避免内存浪费。\\r\\n\\r\\n### 3.2 并发与异步\\r\\n- **主线程减负**：耗时操作（IO、复杂计算、网络请求）必须移至后台线程。\\r\\n- **TaskPool**：优先使用 `TaskPool` 处理短时任务，系统会自动管理线程生命周期。\\r\\n- **Worker**：适用于长时间运行的后台任务。\\r\\n- **Promise**：异步操作统一使用 Promise 或 async/await，避免回调地狱。\\r\\n\\r\\n### 3.3 内存管理\\r\\n- **资源释放**：组件销毁时 (`aboutToDisappear`) 及时注销事件监听、定时器和后台任务。\\r\\n- **上下文泄漏**：避免在长生命周期对象中持有 AbilityContext 或 UI 组件引用。\\r\\n\\r\\n## 4. 项目架构与工程规范\\r\\n\\r\\n### 4.1 目录结构\\r\\n```text\\r\\nentry/src/main/ets/\\r\\n├── pages/          # 页面入口 (@Entry)\\r\\n├── components/     # 公共 UI 组件\\r\\n├── model/          # 数据模型 (Class/Interface)\\r\\n├── utils/          # 工具类\\r\\n├── service/        # 业务逻辑服务 (API, Database)\\r\\n├── common/         # 全局常量、枚举\\r\\n└── resources/      # 静态资源\\r\\n```\\r\\n\\r\\n### 4.2 命名规范\\r\\n- **类/接口/组件**：PascalCase (e.g., `UserComponent`, `DataService`)\\r\\n- **变量/函数/方法**：camelCase (e.g., `fetchUserData`, `isOpen`)\\r\\n- **常量/枚举值**：UPPER_SNAKE_CASE (e.g., Syntax Assistant\\r\\n\\r\\n[中文文档](SKILL.zh.md)\\r\\n\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n## Overview\\r\\n\\r\\nArkTS is the default development language for OpenHarmony applications. It builds\\r\\nupon TypeScript with enhanced static typing to improve program stability and\\r\\nperformance.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Core Features\\r\\n\\r\\n- **Static Typing**: All types determined at compile time, reducing runtime checks\\r\\n- **No Dynamic Object Layout**: Object structure fixed at compile time, cannot be\\r\\n  modified at runtime\\r\\n- **Restricted Operators**: Some operator behaviors are restricted to encourage\\r\\n  clearer code semantics\\r\\n- **No Structural Typing**: Structural typing is currently not supported\\r\\n\\r\\n## Reference Documentation\\r\\n\\r\\n| Scenario | Document |\\r\\n|----------|----------|\\r\\n| Syntax Learning | [references/en/introduction-to-arkts.md](references/en/introduction-to-arkts.md) |\\r\\n| Quick Overview | [references/en/arkts-get-started.md](references/en/arkts-get-started.md) |\\r\\n| TS Migration | [references/en/typescript-to-arkts-migration-guide.md](references/en/typescript-to-arkts-migration-guide.md) |\\r\\n| Migration Background | [references/en/arkts-migration-background.md](references/en/arkts-migration-background.md) |\\r\\n| Performance | [references/en/arkts-high-performance-programming.md](references/en/arkts-high-performance-programming.md) |\\r\\n| More Cases | [references/en/arkts-more-cases.md](references/en/arkts-more-cases.md) |\\r\\n\\r\\n## Workflows\\r\\n\\r\\n### 1. Syntax Questions\\r\\n\\r\\n```\\r\\nUser Question -> Identify Question Type -> Consult Documentation -> Provide Code Example\\r\\n```\\r\\n\\r\\n**Common Syntax Questions**:\\r\\n- Variable declaration -> Use `let`/`const` with explicit type or inference\\r\\n- Function definition -> Supports optional parameters, defaults, rest parameters,\\r\\n  arrow functions\\r\\n- Classes and interfaces -> Must initialize fields, supports inheritance and\\r\\n  implementation\\r\\n- Generics -> Supports constraints and default values\\r\\n- Null safety -> Nullable types ((T | null)), non-null assertion ((!)), optional\\r\\n  chaining ((?.))\\r\\n\\r\\n### 2. TypeScript Migration\\r\\n\\r\\n```\\r\\nIdentify TS Code -> Check Incompatible Features -> Consult Migration Rules -> Provide ArkTS Alternative\\r\\n```\\r\\n\\r\\n**Key Migration Rules Quick Reference**:\\r\\n\\r\\n| TypeScript | ArkTS Alternative |\\r\\n|------------|-------------------|\\r\\n| `var x` | `let x` |\\r\\n| `any`/`unknown` | Specific types |\\r\\n| `{n: 42}` object literal | Define class/interface first |\\r\\n| `[index: T]: U` index signature | `Record<T, U>` |\\r\\n| `A & B` intersection type | `interface C extends A, B` |\\r\\n| `function(){}` function expression | `() => {}` arrow function |\\r\\n| `<Type>value` type assertion | `value as Type` |\\r\\n| Destructuring `[a, b] = arr` | Individual access `arr[0]`, `arr[1]` |\\r\\n| `for..in` | `for` loop or `for..of` |\\r\\n| Constructor parameter properties | Explicit field declaration |\\r\\n\\r\\n### 3. Performance Optimization\\r\\n\\r\\n```\\r\\nAnalyze Code -> Identify Performance Issues -> Consult Optimization Guide -> Provide Solutions\\r\\n```\\r\\n\\r\\n**High-Performance Programming Key Points**:\\r\\n\\r\\n- **Declarations**: Use `const` for invariants; avoid mixing integer and float\\r\\n- **Loops**: Extract loop invariants; avoid numeric overflow\\r\\n- **Functions**: Parameter passing preferred over closures; avoid optional\\r\\n  parameters\\r\\n- **Arrays**: Use TypedArray for numeric values; avoid sparse arrays and union\\r\\n  type arrays\\r\\n- **Exceptions**: Avoid throwing in loops; use return values instead\\r\\n\\r\\n### 4. Compile Error Resolution\\r\\n\\r\\n```\\r\\nGet Error Message -> Search Migration Rules -> Find Related Case -> Provide Fix\\r\\n```\\r\\n\\r\\n## Common Questions\\r\\n\\r\\n### Q: How to handle JSON.parse return value?\\r\\n\\r\\n```typescript\\r\\n// Error\\r\\nlet data = JSON.parse(str);\\r\\n\\r\\n// Correct\\r\\nlet data: Record<string, Object> = JSON.parse(str);\\r\\n```\\r\\n\\r\\n### Q: How to define object types?\\r\\n\\r\\n```typescript\\r\\n// TypeScript syntax (not supported in ArkTS)\\r\\ntype Person = { name: string, age: number }\\r\\n\\r\\n// ArkTS syntax\\r\\ninterface Person {\\r\\n  name: string;\\r\\n  age: number;\\r\\n}\\r\\n\\r\\n// Using object literal\\r\\nlet p: Person = { name: 'John', age: 25 };\\r\\n```\\r\\n\\r\\n### Q: How to replace globalThis?\\r\\n\\r\\n```typescript\\r\\n// Error\\r\\nglobalThis.value = 'xxx';\\r\\n\\r\\n// Use singleton pattern\\r\\nexport class GlobalContext {\\r\\n  private constructor() {}\\r\\n  private static instance: GlobalContext;\\r\\n  private _objects = new Map<string, Object>();\\r\\n\\r\\n  public static getContext(): GlobalContext {\\r\\n    if (!GlobalContext.instance) {\\r\\n      GlobalContext.instance = new GlobalContext();\\r\\n    }\\r\\n    return GlobalContext.instance;\\r\\n  }\\r\\n\\r\\n  getObject(key: string): Object | undefined {\\r\\n    return this._objects.get(key);\\r\\n  }\\r\\n\\r\\n  setObject(key: string, value: Object): void {\\r\\n    this._objects.set(key, value);\\r\\n  }\\r\\n}\\r\\n```\\r\\n\\r\\n### Q: How to handle error types in catch?\\r\\n\\r\\n```typescript\\r\\n// Error\\r\\ntry {} catch (e: BusinessError) {}\\r\\n\\r\\n// Correct\\r\\ntry {} catch (error) {\\r\\n  let e: BusinessError = error as BusinessError;\\r\\n}\\r\\n```\\r\\n\\r\\n### Q: How to use Record type?\\r\\n\\r\\n```typescript\\r\\n// TypeScript index signature\\r\\nfunction foo(data: { [key: string]: string }) {}\\r\\n\\r\\n// ArkTS Record\\r\\nfunction foo(data: Record<string, string>) {}\\r\\n\\r\\n// Usage example\\r\\nlet map: Record<string, number> = {\\r\\n  'John': 25,\\r\\n  'Mary': 21,\\r\\n};\\r\\n```\\r\\n\\r\\n### Q: How to replace constructor signatures with factory functions?\\r\\n\\r\\n```typescript\\r\\n// TypeScript constructor signature\\r\\ntype ControllerCtor = {\\r\\n  new (value: string): Controller;\\r\\n}\\r\\n\\r\\n// ArkTS factory function\\r\\ntype ControllerFactory = () => Controller;\\r\\n\\r\\nclass Menu {\\r\\n  createController: ControllerFactory = () => {\\r\\n    return new Controller('default');\\r\\n  }\\r\\n}\\r\\n```\\r\\n\\r\\n## Prohibited Standard Library APIs\\r\\n\\r\\nThe following are prohibited in ArkTS:\\r\\n\\r\\n- **Global**: `eval`\\r\\n- **Object**: `__proto__`, `defineProperty`, `freeze`, `getPrototypeOf`, etc.\\r\\n- **Reflect**: `apply`, `construct`, `defineProperty`, etc.\\r\\n- **Proxy**: All handler methods\\r\\n\\r\\n## Build Scripts\\r\\n\\r\\nThe scripts directory provides quick compilation scripts for ArkTS projects\\r\\n(including dependency installation):\\r\\n\\r\\n| Platform | Script | Purpose |\\r\\n|----------|--------|---------|\\r\\n| macOS/Linux | `scripts/run.sh` | Execute `ohpm install` + `hvigorw assembleApp` |\\r\\n| Windows | `scripts/run.ps1` | Execute `ohpm install` + `hvigorw assembleApp` |\\r\\n\\r\\nUsage:\\r\\n```bash\\r\\n# macOS/Linux\\r\\nbash scripts/run.sh\\r\\n\\r\\n# Windows PowerShell\\r\\n.\\\\scripts\\\\run.ps1\\r\\n```\\r\\n\\r\\nScript execution steps:\\r\\n1. Install dependencies (`ohpm install --all`)\\r\\n2. Build project (`hvigorw assembleApp`)\\r\\n\\r\\n## Mandatory Requirements\\r\\n\\r\\n**CRITICAL**: When this skill generates ArkTS code, the following workflow MUST be followed:\\r\\n\\r\\n1. **Compilation Verification**: After generating code, you MUST compile the project using the build scripts:\\r\\n   - macOS/Linux: `bash scripts/run.sh`\\r\\n   - Windows: `.\\\\scripts\\\\run.ps1`\\r\\n\\r\\n2. **Retry Strategy**: If compilation fails:\\r\\n   - Analyze the error output\\r\\n   - Fix the issue and retry compilation\\r\\n   - Maximum of **3 compilation attempts**\\r\\n\\r\\n3. **User Intervention**: After 3 failed compilation attempts, use `AskUserQuestion`:\\r\\n   ```\\r\\n   Question: Compilation failed after 3 attempts. How would you like to proceed?\\r\\n   Options:\\r\\n   - Continue retrying (attempt another fix)\\r\\n   - Manual intervention (I'll wait for your guidance)\\r\\n   - Skip compilation (proceed without verification)\\r\\n   ```\\r\\n\\r\\n4. **Error Reporting**: Always show the full compilation error output when failures occur.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Answer Guidelines\\r\\n\\r\\n1. **Prioritize code examples**: Show correct vs incorrect syntax comparison\\r\\n2. **Reference official documentation**: For detailed explanations, guide users to\\r\\n   consult corresponding documents in references/\\r\\n3. **Explain reasons**: Explain why ArkTS has this restriction (performance,\\r\\n   stability)\\r\\n4. **Provide alternatives**: For unsupported features, provide feasible\\r\\n  alternatives\\r\\n\\r\\n## License\\r\\n\\r\\nMIT License - see [LICENSE.txt](LICENSE.txt)\\r\\n---\\r\\nname: hmos-arkts-knowledge-retriever\\r\\ndescription: Retrieve grounded ArkTS references for pure non-UI ArkTS work and ArkTS API usage. Use this skill whenever the user is writing, reviewing, testing, validating, running, or debugging ArkTS code and the answer should be backed by repository sources such as `docs/ArkTS-Language-Guide/`, `docs/ArkTS-API-Reference/`, the linter-derived `docs/linter/ArkTS_Syntax_Knowledge_From_Linter.md`, and the bundled lightweight lint tool docs `docs/linter/linter-cli.md` plus `linter-cli/` instead of model memory. This skill is especially useful for syntax rules, ArkTS-specific restrictions, API/module/member lookup, common-library usage, lightweight lint workflow lookup, runnable example lookup, snippet validation context, and figuring out which repository section to trust before suggesting code or fixes.\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n# ArkTS Retrieval Skill\\r\\n\\r\\nUse this skill to find real ArkTS documentation quickly and return traceable references.\\r\\n\\r\\nThis skill is for retrieval. It does not default to running validation or execution tools automatically. In this copied package, prefer commands that work inside the package itself.\\r\\n\\r\\nIn the source repository, this skill lives under `skills/arkts-skill/`. This copied package is self-contained. Open cited markdown files under `docs/ArkTS-Language-Guide/`, `docs/ArkTS-API-Reference/`, or `docs/linter/` when you need the original context.\\r\\n\\r\\n## What this skill covers\\r\\n\\r\\n- Pure non-UI ArkTS syntax and language rules from `docs/ArkTS-Language-Guide/02-Basic-Syntax`\\r\\n- ArkTS-specific syntax constraints and boundary cases summarized from `docs/linter/ArkTS_Syntax_Knowledge_From_Linter.md`\\r\\n- Common-library usage from `docs/ArkTS-Language-Guide/03-Common-Library`\\r\\n- OpenHarmony ArkTS API reference material from `docs/ArkTS-API-Reference/`, including imports, parameters, return values, API versions, system capabilities, and error codes\\r\\n- Lightweight ArkTS lint workflow notes from `docs/linter/linter-cli.md` and the bundled `linter-cli/` package\\r\\n- Concurrency, runtime, toolchain, migration, and related language-guide sections when the query clearly points there\\r\\n- Snippet-level validation metadata derived from the repository's snippet framework\\r\\n- Grounded references for pure non-UI `.ets` topics inside this copied package, without assuming external validation tools are present\\r\\n\\r\\n## Required behavior\\r\\n\\r\\n1. Ground the answer in local repository sources, not in vague prior knowledge.\\r\\n2. Treat `docs/ArkTS-Language-Guide/` as the primary source for normative language explanations, `docs/ArkTS-API-Reference/` as the primary source for API/module/member details, and `docs/linter/ArkTS_Syntax_Knowledge_From_Linter.md` as implementation-derived evidence for ArkTS-specific restrictions and edge cases.\\r\\n3. Prefer pure non-UI and validation-backed references when multiple sections could fit.\\r\\n4. When a result comes from the linter summary, say that clearly instead of presenting it as official spec text. When a result comes from the API reference, do not treat its examples as pure non-UI snippet validation evidence.\\r\\n5. 子分区本地状态：`webdavResult`、`webdavBackupResult`、`webdavBusy`（[同文件](../entry/src/main/ets/pages/settings/SettingsSyncSection.ets:41)）。手动备份包装器先检查 busy，再置 busy、赋值“正在备份到云端...”、等待 50ms、等待真实异步操作，`finally` 清 busy（[同文件](../entry/src/main/ets/pages/settings/SettingsSyncSection.ets:141)）。\r\n- busy 期间保存/测试/同步/备份/恢复五个按钮均显示“处理中...”且 `.enabled(!webdavBusy)`（[同文件](../entry/src/main/ets/pages/settings/SettingsSyncSection.ets:543)、[578](../entry/src/main/ets/pages/settings/SettingsSyncSection.ets:578)、[594](../entry/src/main/ets/pages/settings/SettingsSyncSection.ets:594)）；备份结果文本位于 [同文件](../entry/src/main/ets/pages/settings/SettingsSyncSection.ets:618)。本次 UI 树证实这五个按钮被禁用、文字可见。\r\n- UI 包装器超时为 **120000ms**，以 `Promise.race` 实现（[同文件](../entry/src/main/ets/pages/settings/SettingsSyncSection.ets:114)）。该方法没有取消底层操作的代码；`INFERENCE`：超时后 UI busy 可能先恢复，而网络/后台操作仍未完成。**未实测超时**。\r\n- `WebDavSettings` 含 endpoint、username、password、syncPassword、remoteRoot 及 JSON 序列化（[WebDavCommon.ets](../entry/src/main/ets/sync/webdav/WebDavCommon.ets:49)）；`WebDavManifest` 含设备 ID、同步/备份时间戳和 ETag 等状态（[同文件](../entry/src/main/ets/sync/webdav/WebDavCommon.ets:102)）。经理单例持有设置、manifest 和自身 `WebDavSyncStatus`（[WebDavSyncManager.ets](../entry/src/main/ets/sync/WebDavSyncManager.ets:71)），与 UI 的 `webdavBusy` 是不同状态变量。\r\n- “保存设置”构造 `WebDavSettings` 并调用经理 `setSettings`（[SettingsSyncSection.ets](../entry/src/main/ets/pages/settings/SettingsSyncSection.ets:100)）；经理更新内存并保存 JSON（[WebDavSyncManager.ets](../entry/src/main/ets/sync/WebDavSyncManager.ets:115)）。初始化读取本地 JSON，父页从经理装载字段（[同文件](../entry/src/main/ets/sync/WebDavSyncManager.ets:132)、[SettingsPage.ets](../entry/src/main/ets/pages/SettingsPage.ets:190)）。\r\n- 本地 WebDAV 状态使用 `@ohos.data.preferences`，存储名 `webdav_state_store`；配置主/备份键为 `webdav_settings_json`、`webdav_settings_json_bak`、`webdav_settings_json_bak_ts`（[WebDavStateStore.ets](../entry/src/main/ets/utils/WebDavStateStore.ets:62)）。`initialize` 使用 `preferences.getPreferences`（[同文件](../entry/src/main/ets/utils/WebDavStateStore.ets:120)），读写入口为 `getSettingsJson` / `saveSettingsJson`（[同文件](../entry/src/main/ets/utils/WebDavStateStore.ets:146)）。本次没有直接读取设备 Preferences 文件，也未验证重启持久化。\r\n- 真实备份经理入口 `backupToCloudInBackground()` 先检查配置和自身同步状态、预检远端目录，进入内部 `try` 后调用 `DataSyncManager.exportData()`，再 `executeTaskWithFallback(executeBackupWithEncrypt, params)`（[WebDavSyncManager.ets](../entry/src/main/ets/sync/WebDavSyncManager.ets:911)）。只有进入该内部 `try/finally` 的分支，才由 [finally](../entry/src/main/ets/sync/WebDavSyncManager.ets:1001) 恢复经理 `IDLE`；预检返回失败会提前设为 `ERROR` 并返回，预检抛异常也不经过该 `finally`（[预检位置](../entry/src/main/ets/sync/WebDavSyncManager.ets:930)）。导出使用现有 DBManager（[DataSyncManager.ets](../entry/src/main/ets/sync/DataSyncManager.ets:87)、[导出入口](../entry/src/main/ets/sync/DataSyncManager.ets:140)）。\r\n- `@Concurrent executeBackupWithEncrypt` 执行加密和 PUT（[WebDavSyncTask.ets](../entry/src/main/ets/sync/webdav/WebDavSyncTask.ets:148)）；文件名 `backup.json.enc` 来自 [WebDavCommon.ets](../entry/src/main/ets/sync/webdav/WebDavCommon.ets:250)，远端路径组合见 [WebDavSyncManager.ets](../entry/src/main/ets/sync/WebDavSyncManager.ets:214)。\r\n- `WebDavClient` 用 `@ohos.net.http`，构造 Basic Auth，提供 HEAD、GET、PUT 等（[WebDavClient.ets](../entry/src/main/ets/sync/webdav/WebDavClient.ets:27)）；PUT 前检查父目录（[同文件](../entry/src/main/ets/sync/webdav/WebDavClient.ets:41)），HTTP 连接/读取超时为 15000/20000ms（[同文件](../entry/src/main/ets/sync/webdav/WebDavClient.ets:139)）。INTERNET 权限已声明（[module.json5](../entry/src/main/module.json5:15)）。\r\n\r\n`RUNTIME_OBSERVED`：本次应用日志记录导出 0 words、0 user word Spec 缺失能力与逐场景基线判定\r\n\r\n`SPEC_EXPLICIT`：[requirement.md](requirement.md:7) 要求备份进行时渲染 ArkUI `LoadingProgress`；[场景二](requirement.md:20) 要求进行中的文字；[场景三](requirement.md:33) 要求加载状态绑定真实请求。\r\n\r\n| Spec 场景/步骤 | 基线判定 | 证据范围 |\r\n| --- | --- | --- |\r\n| 场景一 1：进入并填写可访问配置 | `pass` | 本次合成端点保存成功，服务端收到有效认证的请求；不是任意配置皆可用 |\r\n| 场景一 2–3：点击“立即备份”，进入忙碌 | `pass` | [observe-backup.log](../logs/baseline-20261016/observe-backup.log:1)、07/08/09/10 UI 树和截图 |\r\n| 场景一 4：忙碌期间显示 ArkUI `LoadingProgress` | **`fail`** | 07/08/09/10 UI 树 `LoadingProgress` 均为 0；09 截图无指示器；备份分区源码未构造该组件 |\r\n| 场景二 1–4：备份操作期间显示忙碌文案 | `pass`，仅本次已保存合成配置的单次成功路径 | 多次离散采样都有五个“处理中...”和“正在备份到云端...”；未证明所有异常/生命周期路径 |\r\n| 场景三 1–4：忙碌状态绑定真实 WebDAV 请求 | `pass`，仅本次已保存合成配置的单次成功路径 | 主机同一 UTC 时钟记录的 09 采样完整落在 PUT 的 received/responded 之间；下列最小复现和时间线 |\r\n| 成功后结果及恢复（合理推导的观察） | `pass`，单次 | [11-settled.json](../logs/baseline-20261016/11-settled.json:1) / PNG：五个按钮重新 enabled，显示“✅ 备份已上传” |\r\n| 仅填写未保存就点击备份 | `not_run` | 仅保存了 04 未保存配置截图，**没有在未保存状态点击备份**。代码路径见下 |\r\n| 空值/纯空格、无配置、错误认证、HTTP 失败/超时、快速连点、取消/关闭、返回重进、重启、操作中离开、不同数据量 | `not_run` | 本次只做未修改基线摸底，不把静态阅读或成功路径外推为通过 |\r\n\r\n没有设备/签名环境 `blocked`；整题仍有明确 `fail`，不得将编译成功计为整题通过。\r\n\r\n最小失败复现：\r\n\r\n1. 安装上述哈希的基线 HAP，启动并按第 3 节进入目标分区。\r\n2. 启动 [webdav-fixture.py](../logs/baseline-20261016/webdav-fixture.py:1)，使用 `hdc -t 127.0.0.1:5555 rport tcp:18173 tcp:18173` 将设备端口转发至本机。fixture 对 HEAD 返回 200；收到备份 PUT 后等待 8 秒，返回 201。\r\n3. UI 填入 endpoint `http://127.0.0.1:18173`、username `vg13-fixture`、password `fixture-pass`、同步密码 `fixture-sync-pass`、目录 `/vg13-baseline`，关闭自动同步并点击“保存设置”。这些都是本次合成凭据。\r\n4. 滚动到手动操作，点击“立即备份”，在服务端 PUT 尚未响应时 dumpLayout / screenCap。实际配置和操作脚本为 [ui-config.py](../logs/baseline-20261016/ui-config.py:1)、[observe-backup.py](../logs/baseline-20261016/observe-backup.py:1)，原始执行日志分别为同名 `.log`。配置与观察脚本退出码均 `0`。\r\n\r\n期望：备份仍在执行时，页面包含可见 ArkUI `LoadingProgress`。实际：只有禁用按钮上的“处理中...”和备份结果位置的“正在备份到云端...”；没有 `LoadingProgress`。关联：场景一第 4 步。归因假设：`SettingsSyncSection` 有 busy 状态和文案，Builder 没有构造指\n... command output truncated for persistence ...\n7/A11\r\n    state BackupRunning {\r\n        [*] --> Preparing\r\n        Preparing --> RequestInFlight: 发出真实WebDAV请求 A13/A14\r\n        RequestInFlight --> MoreWork: 响应后流程仍未结束\r\n        MoreWork --> RequestInFlight: 如有后续真实请求\r\n        MoreWork --> Finished: 实际操作完成\r\n        RequestInFlight --> Finished: 最终响应使操作终结\r\n    }\r\n    BackupRunning --> Success: 真实操作成功结束 D01\r\n    BackupRunning --> Failed: 失败结果或异常终结 D02/D03\r\n    Success --> Idle: 清理busy/进行中UI D01\r\n    Failed --> Idle: finally等效清理 D02/D03\r\n    BackupRunning --> LeftPage: 返回或关闭 U06/U07\r\n    LeftPage --> Configured: 重进时恢复策略待确认 U07\r\n    BackupRunning --> ProcessStopped: 强制退出或重启 U08\r\n    ProcessStopped --> Configured: 重启后策略待确认 U08\r\n```\r\n\r\n绑定规则：A05/A06 要求备份运行时存在可见 `LoadingProgress`；A09/A10 要求同期间进行中文字可见；A16 要求同一忙碌可见流程发送真实请求。Preparing 包括导出、加密或请求准备，**不要求从点击开始的每一瞬间都已有请求**。用网络延迟制造一个可观察的运行窗口；不能用计时器做一个没有真实备份的假加载。\r\n\r\nSpec 未要求某种 HTTP 方法、固定请求数、固定文件名、服务端必须成功、百分比进度、固定显示时长或上传后恢复路由。它要求真实备份操作中的真实 WebDAV 请求；仅伪造 console、请求无关 URL 或只更改 UI 都不能当成满足。对于“仅预检而无上传是否足够”，保留 U02，不擅自扩大明文。\r\n\r\n### 6.2 基线真实调用链与超时分叉（BASELINE_CODE）\r\n\r\n```mermaid\r\nstateDiagram-v2\r\n    [*] --> UIIdle\r\n    UIIdle --> UIBusy: 点击备份，guard通过 C4\r\n    UIBusy --> ManagerCheck: busy=true，写正在备份到云端，等待50ms\r\n    ManagerCheck --> FinalUI: 配置缺失或已有SYNCING，返回失败 C6/C7\r\n    ManagerCheck --> Preflight: manager置SYNCING\r\n    Preflight --> Export: 缓存或目录可达/准备完成 C8\r\n    Preflight --> FinalUI: 预检返回失败，manager=ERROR\r\n    Preflight --> OuterCatch: 预检抛异常，未进manager的try\r\n    Export --> EncryptTask: 导出成功 C7\r\n    Export --> ManagerFinally: 导出失败或try内异常\r\n    EncryptTask --> ParentCheck: 加密成功 C9\r\n    EncryptTask --> ManagerFinally: 加密失败\r\n    ParentCheck --> BackupPUT: 可能HEAD及PUT .keep C10\r\n    BackupPUT --> ManagerFinally: HTTP结果或任务失败 C9\r\n    ManagerFinally --> FinalUI: manager=IDLE，返回结果 C7\r\n    OuterCatch --> FinalUI: UI包装catch处理 C4\r\n    FinalUI --> UIIdle: 写结果，UI finally busy=false C4\r\n    UIBusy --> UITimedOut: 外层Promise.race达到120000ms C4\r\n    UITimedOut --> UIIdle: UI写异常并finally解除busy\r\n    UITimedOut --> IOStillPossible: 无取消底层Promise的代码\r\n    IOStillPossible --> LateCompletion: 原操作以后才完成，可能有远端副作用\r\n```\r\n\r\n读取此图时必须区分两个时钟：**UI 等待 Promise 已拒绝**，不证明**底层 I/O 已取消**。外层超时后 spinner 是否必须继续显示、能否发起下一轮、晚到成功如何呈现，Spec 未作规定，见 U06；此处只列基线风险。C4 UI finally 不能证明 manager 也始终复位；C7 预检抛错发生在 manager try/finally 外。不得在分析阶段修复，也不得把这些附加风险一律标成官方功能失败。\r\n\r\n基线网络序列：`webdavBackup()` → `backupToCloudInBackground()` → 可选预检 → 本地导出 → 加密任务 → `WebDavClient.put(backupFilePath, ...)` → 真实 `http.request`。PUT 前还可能检查父目录。预检缓存/根目录分支可能无请求；成功上传路径的 PUT 是现有实现事实，**不是把 PUT、HEAD、DELETE 或某个请求数提升为 SPEC_EXPLICIT**。当前按钮不调用 `WebDavBackupManager.backupToCloud()`，不能把那个方法的后续 HEAD 误写进本按钮的必经链路。\r\n\r\n### 6.3 每个相关用户动作是否触发请求\r\n\r\n“新请求”与在途请求分开统计。下表没有把非备份功能扩展为本题新增实现目标。\r\n\r\n| 动作 | 基线静态请求触发 | 本题验收解释 / loading 绑定 |\r\n| --- | --- | --- |\r\n| 进入 WebDAV 分区 | C1/C2/C3 读取配置及自动同步设置，无该按钮的备份请求调用；C13前台事件可能启动自动同步 | 不是备份触发；启动/前台自动同步若发生，需单独归因。仅进入不算 A13。 |\r\n| 填写/修改五个字段 | C3/C5 仅赋值 @Link，无请求 | 不用填字段时的 UI 变化证明备份；本次输入未保存是否生效见 U01。 |\r\n| 点「保存设置」 | C3/C6 设置管理器缓存并保存本地配置，无 WebDAV 请求调用 | 可以作为隔离环境的测试准备，但不得冒充 Spec 明文必经步骤。 |\r\n| 关闭/终止应用并重启 | 源码不足以证明设备/进程生命周期及自动同步运行结果 | 不把重启自动备份当作 Spec 需求；终结/恢复策略 U08，实际现象待运行。 |\r\n| 其它操作/自动同步占用经理时点备份 | C7 status 为 SYNCING 时可直接失败；与 UI 本地 busy 是两层状态 | 不能拿其它任务请求当手动备份成功证据；是否排队/报忙 U05。 For details about the full feature list, detailed code examples, and workaround suggestions, see [Recipes](#recipes). For more cases, see [Adaptation Cases](arkts-more-cases.md).\r\n\r\n### Static Typing Is Enforced\r\n\r\nOne of the most important features of ArkTS is static typing. If a program is statically typed (all types are known at compile time), it is much easier to understand what data structures are used in the code. Since all types are known before the program actually runs, the compiler can verify code correctness, thereby eliminating many runtime type checks and improving performance.\r\n\r\nTherefore, the usage of the type **any** in ArkTS is prohibited.\r\n\r\n**Example**\r\n\r\n```typescript\r\n// Not supported:\r\nlet res: any = some_api_function('hello', 'world');\r\n// Supported:\r\nclass CallResult {\r\n  public succeeded(): boolean {\r\n    return false;\r\n  }\r\n  public errorMessage(): string {\r\n    return '123';\r\n  }\r\n}\r\nfunction some_api_function(param1: string, param2: string): CallResult {\r\n  return new CallResult();\r\n}\r\n\r\nlet res: CallResult = some_api_function('hello', 'world');\r\nif (!res.succeeded()) {\r\n  console.info('Call failed: ' + res.errorMessage());   \r\n}  \r\n```\r\n\r\nAccording to our measurements, **any** is already not welcome in TypeScript. It is used in approximately 1% of TypeScript codebases. Moreover, today's code linters (for example, ESLint) include a set of rules that prohibit the usage of **any**. Prohibiting **any** results in a strong positive impact on performance at the cost of low-effort code refactoring.\r\n\r\n### Changing Object Layout in Runtime Is Prohibited\r\n\r\nTo achieve maximum performance benefits, ArkTS requires the layout of objects to remain unchanged during program execution. In other words, it is prohibited to:\r\n\r\n- Add new properties or methods to objects.\r\n- Delete existing properties or methods from objects.\r\n- Assign values of arbitrary types to object properties.\r\n\r\nIt is noteworthy that many such operations are already prohibited by the TS compiler. However, it can still be \"tricked\" by, for example, using **as any** to convert the object type, disabling strict type check when compiling TS code, or ignoring type check using **@ts-ignore** in the code.\r\n\r\nIn ArkTS, strict type check is not configurable. ArkTS enforces strict type check and prohibits the use of **any** and **@ts-ignore** in the code.\r\n\r\n**Example**\r\n\r\n```typescript\r\nclass Point {\r\n  public x: number = 0\r\n  public y: number = 0\r\n\r\n  constructor(x: number, y: number) {\r\n    this.x = x;\r\n    this.y = y;\r\n  }\r\n}\r\n\r\n// It is impossible to delete a property from the object. It is guaranteed that all Point objects have the property x.\r\nlet p1 = new Point(1.0, 1.0);\r\ndelete p1.x;           // Compile-time error in TypeScript and ArkTS\r\ndelete (p1 as any).x;  // OK in TypeScript; compile-time error in ArkTS\r\n\r\n// Class Point does not define any property named `z`, and it is impossible to add it while the program runs.\r\nlet p2 = new Point(2.0, 2.0);\r\np2.z = 'Label';           // Compile-time error in TypeScript and ArkTS\r\n(p2 as any).z = 'Label';   // OK in TypeScript; compile-time error in ArkTS\r\n\r\n// It is guaranteed that all Point objects have only properties x and y and other properties cannot be added.\r\nlet p3 = new Point(3.0, 3.0);\r\nlet prop = Symbol();      // OK in TypeScript; compile-time error in ArkTS\r\n(p3 as any)[prop] = p3.x; // OK in TypeScript; compile-time error in ArkTS\r\np3[prop] = p3.x;          // Compile-time error in TypeScript and ArkTS\r\n\r\n// It is guaranteed that all Point objects have properties x and y of type number, so assigning a value of any other type is impossible:\r\nlet p4 = new Point(4.0, 4.0);\r\np4.x = 'Hello!';          // Compile-time error in TypeScript and ArkTS\r\n(p4 as any).x = 'Hello!'; // OK in TypeScript; compile-time error in ArkTS\r\n\r\n// Usage of Point objects which is compliant with the class definition:\r\nfunction distance(p1: Point, p2: Point): number {\r\n  return Math.sqrt(\r\n    (p2.x - p1.x) * (p2.x - p1.x) + (p2.y - p1.y) * (p2.y - p1.y)\r\n  );\r\n}\r\nlet p5 = new Point(5.0, 5.0);\r\nlet p6 = new Point(6.0, 6.0);\r\nconsole.info('Distance between p5 and p6: ' + distance(p5, p6));\r\n```\r\n\r\nUnpredictable changing of object layout contradicts both good readability and good performance of code. Indeed, having class definition at one place and modifying actual object layout elsewhere is confusing and error-prone from the developer's point of view. It opposes the idea of static typing and requires extra runtime support that causes undesired execution overhead. When an explicit type is used, properties cannot be added or deleted.\r\n\r\nCurrently, only a few projects allow object layout changes at runtime, and some common code linters have added corresponding constraints. Although a small amount of code refactoring is required, the performance improvement benefits are considerable.\r\n\r\n### Semantics of Operators Is Restricted\r\n\r\nTo achieve better performance and encourage developers to write clearer code, ArkTS restricts the semantics of some operators. An example is given below, and the full list of constraints is outlined in [Recipes](#recipes).\r\n\r\n**Example**\r\n\r\n```typescript\r\n// Unary `+` is defined only for numbers, but not for strings:\r\nlet t = +42;   // OK\r\nlet s = +'42'; // Compile-time error\r\n```\r\n\r\nLoading language operators with extra semantics complicates the language specification, and forces developers to remember all possible corner cases with appropriate handling rules. Besides, in certain cases it causes some undesired runtime overhead.\r\n\r\nAccording to our observations and experiments, this feature is not popular in TypeScript. It is used in less than 1% of real-world codebases, and such cases are easy to refactor. After code refactoring based on the recipes in this topic, the code is still valid TypeScript code.\\r\\n\\r\\n**Example**\\r\\n\\r\\nOriginal TypeScript code containing the keyword **var**:\\r\\n\\r\\n```typescript\\r\\nfunction addTen(x: number): number {\\r\\n  var ten = 10;\\r\\n  return x + ten;\\r\\n}\\r\\n```\\r\\n\\r\\nRefactored code:\\r\\n\\r\\n```typescript\\r\\nfunction addTen(x: number): number {\\r\\n  let ten = 10;\\r\\n  return x + ten;\\r\\n}\\r\\n```\\r\\n\\r\\n**Severity levels**\\r\\n\\r\\nEach recipe is marked with the severity level.\\r\\n\\r\\n- Error: The recipe should be followed, otherwise the program will fail to compile.\\r\\n- Warning: It is highly recommended to follow the recipe. Although violating the recipe does not currently affect the compilation, in future versions, it will cause compilation to fail.\\r\\n\\r\\n**Unsupported Features**\\r\\n\\r\\nCurrently, unsupported features are mainly either of the following:\\r\\n\\r\\n- Features relate to dynamic typing that degrades runtime performance\\r\\n- Features that require extra support in the compiler, thereby degrading project build time\\r\\n\\r\\nHowever, the ArkTS team reserves the right to reconsider the list and shrink it in the future releases based on the feedback from developers and real-world data experiments.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Recipes Summarized\\r\\n\\r\\nThis topic lists the TypeScript features that are not supported or partially supported by ArkTS. For details about the full feature list, detailed code examples, and workaround suggestions, see [Recipes](#recipes). For more cases, see [Adaptation Cases](arkts-more-cases.md).\\r\\n\\r\\n### Static Typing Is Enforced\\r\\n\\r\\nOne of the most important features of ArkTS is static typing. If a program is statically typed (all types are known at compile time), it is much easier to understand what data structures are used in the code. Since all types are known before the program actually runs, the compiler can verify code correctness, thereby eliminating many runtime type checks and improving performance.\\r\\n\\r\\nTherefore, the usage of the type **any** in ArkTS is prohibited.\\r\\n\\r\\n**Example**\\r\\n\\r\\n```typescript\\r\\n// Not supported:\\r\\nlet res: any = some_api_function('hello', 'world');\\r\\n// Supported:\\r\\nclass CallResult {\\r\\n  public succeeded(): boolean {\\r\\n    return false;\\r\\n  }\\r\\n  public errorMessage(): string {\\r\\n    return '123';\\r\\n  }\\r\\n}\\r\\nfunction some_api_function(param1: string, param2: string): CallResult {\\r\\n  return new CallResult();\\r\\n}\\r\\n\\r\\nlet res: CallResult = some_api_function('hello', 'world');\\r\\nif (!res.succeeded()) {\\r\\n  console.info('Call failed: ' + res.errorMessage());   \\r\\n}  \\r\\n```\\r\\n\\r\\nAccording to our measurements, **any** is already not welcome in TypeScript. It is used in approximately 1% of TypeScript codebases. Moreover, today's code linters (for example, ESLint) include a set of rules that prohibit the usage of **any**. Prohibiting **any** results in a strong positive impact on performance at the cost of low-effort code refactoring.\\r\\n\\r\\n### Changing Object Layout in Runtime Is Prohibited\\r\\n\\r\\nTo achieve maximum performance benefits, ArkTS requires the layout of objects to remain unchanged during program execution. In other words, it is prohibited to:\\r\\n\\r\\n- Add new properties or methods to objects.\\r\\n- Delete existing properties or methods from objects.\\r\\n- Assign values of arbitrary types to object properties.\\r\\n\\r\\nIt is noteworthy that many such operations are already prohibited by the TS compiler. However, it can still be \\\"tricked\\\" by, for example, using **as any** to convert the object type, disabling strict type check when compiling TS code, or ignoring type check using **@ts-ignore** in the code.\\r\\n\\r\\nIn ArkTS, strict type check is not configurable. ArkTS enforces strict type check and prohibits the use of **any** and **@ts-ignore** in the code.\\r\\n\\r\\n**Example**\\r\\n\\r\\n```typescript\\r\\nclass Point {\\r\\n  public x: number = 0\\r\\n  public y: number = 0\\r\\n\\r\\n  constructor(x: number, y: number) {\\r\\n    this.x = x;\\r\\n    this.y = y;\\r\\n  }\\r\\n}\\r\\n\\r\\n// It is impossible to delete a property from the object. It is guaranteed that all Point objects have the property x.\\r\\nlet p1 = new Point(1.0, 1.0);\\r\\ndelete p1.x;           // Compile-time error in TypeScript and ArkTS\\r\\ndelete (p1 as any).x;  // OK in TypeScript; compile-time error in ArkTS\\r\\n\\r\\n// Class Point does not define any property named `z`, and it is impossible to add it while the program runs.\\r\\nlet p2 = new Point(2.0, 2.0);\\r\\np2.z = 'Label';           // Compile-time error in TypeScript and ArkTS\\r\\n(p2 as any).z = 'Label';   // OK in TypeScript; compile-time error in ArkTS\\r\\n\\r\\n// It is guaranteed that all Point objects have only properties x and y and other properties cannot be added.\\r\\nlet p3 = new Point(3.0, 3.0);\\r\\nlet prop = Symbol();      // OK in TypeScript; compile-time error in ArkTS\\r\\n(p3 as any)[prop] = p3.x; // OK in TypeScript; compile-time error in ArkTS\\r\\np3[prop] = p3.x;          // Compile-time error in TypeScript and ArkTS\\r\\n\\r\\n// It is guaranteed that all Point objects have properties x and y of type number, so assigning a value of any other type is impossible:\\r\\nlet p4 = new Point(4.0, 4.0);\\r\\np4.x = 'Hello!';          // Compile-time error in TypeScript and ArkTS\\r\\n(p4 as any).x = 'Hello!'; // OK in TypeScript; compile-time error in ArkTS\\r\\n\\r\\n// Usage of Point objects which is compliant with the class definition:\\r\\nfunction distance(p1: Point, p2: Point): number {\\r\\n  return Math.sqrt(\\r\\n    (p2.x - p1.x) * (p2.x - p1.x) + (p2.y - p1.y) * (p2.y - p1.y)\\r\\n  );\\r\\n}\\r\\nlet p5 = new Point(5.0, 5.0);\\r\\nlet p6 = new Point(6.0, 6.0);\\r\\nconsole.info('Distance between p5 and p6: ' + distance(p5, p6));\\r\\n```\\r\\n\\r\\nUnpredictable changing of object layout contradicts both good readability and good performance of code. Indeed, having class definition at one place and modifying actual object layout elsewhere is confusing and error-prone from the developer's point of view. It opposes the idea of static typing and requires extra runtime support that causes undesired execution overhead. When an explicit type is used, properties cannot be added or deleted.\\r\\n\\r\\nCurrently, only a few projects allow object layout changes at runtime, and some common code linters have added corresponding constraints. Although a small amount of code refactoring is required, the performance improvement benefits are considerable.\\r\\n\\r\\n### Semantics of Operators Is Restricted\\r\\n\\r\\nTo achieve better performance and encourage developers to write clearer code, ArkTS restricts the semantics of some operators. An example is given below, and the full list of constraints is outlined in [Recipes](#recipes).\\r\\n\\r\\n**Example**\\r\\n\\r\\n```typescript\\r\\n// Unary `+` is defined only for numbers, but not for strings:\\r\\nlet t = +42;   // OK\\r\\nlet s = +'42'; // Compile-time error\\r\\n```\\r\\n\\r\\nLoading language operators with extra semantics complicates the language specification, and forces developers to remember all possible corner cases with appropriate handling rules. Besides, in certain cases it causes some undesired runtime overhead.\\r\\n\\r\\nAccording to our observations and experiments, this feature is not popular in TypeScript. It is used in less than 1% of real-world codebases, and such cases are easy to refactor. Restricting the operator semantics results in a clearer and more performant at the cost of low-effort changes in code.\\r\\n\\r\\n### Structural Typing Is Not Supported\\r\\n\\r\\nAssume that two unrelated classes **T** and **U** have the same **public** API:\\r\\n\\r\\n```typescript\\r\\nclass T {\\r\\n  public name: string = ''\\r\\n\\r\\n  public greet(): void {\\r\\n    console.info('Hello, ' + this.name);\\r\\n\"}}}"}],"internal_chat_message_metadata_passthrough":{"turn_id":"01a143bf-41b4-7fc1-ad9e-48cc9b3becef","create_time":1792138012.271971}},"metadata":{"client_authored":false,"fallback_token_limit_override":12000}}

子分区本地状态：`webdavResult`、`webdavBackupResult`、`webdavBusy`（[同文件](../entry/src/main/ets/pages/settings/SettingsSyncSection.ets:41)）。手动备份包装器先检查 busy，再置 busy、赋值“正在备份到云端...”、等待 50ms、等待真实异步操作，`finally` 清 busy（[同文件](../entry/src/main/ets/pages/settings/SettingsSyncSection.ets:141)）。\\r\\n- busy 期间保存/测试/同步/备份/恢复五个按钮均显示“处理中...”且 `.enabled(!webdavBusy)`（[同文件](../entry/src/main/ets/pages/settings/SettingsSyncSection.ets:543)、[578](../entry/src/main/ets/pages/settings/SettingsSyncSection.ets:578)、[594](../entry/src/main/ets/pages/settings/SettingsSyncSection.ets:594)）；备份结果文本位于 等状态（[同文件](../entry/src/main/ets/sync/webdav/WebDavCommon.ets:102)）。经理单例持有设置、manifest 和自身 `WebDavSyncStatus`（[WebDavSyncManager.ets](../entry/src/main/ets/sync/WebDavSyncManager.ets:71)），与 UI 的 `webdavBusy` 是不同状态变量。\\r\\n- “保存设置”构造 `WebDavSettings` 并调用经理 `setSettings`（[SettingsSyncSection.ets](../entry/src/main/ets/pages/settings/SettingsSyncSection.ets:100)）；经理更新内存并保存 JSON（[WebDavSyncManager.ets](../entry/src/main/ets/sync/WebDavSyncManager.ets:115)）。初始化读取本地 JSON，父页从经理装载字段（[同文件](../entry/src/main/ets/sync/WebDavSyncManager.ets:132)、[SettingsPage.ets](../entry/src/main/ets/pages/SettingsPage.ets:190)）。\\r\\n- 本地 WebDAV 状态使用 `@ohos.data.preferences`，存储名 `webdav_state_store`；配置主/备份键为 `webdav_settings_json`、`webdav_settings_json_bak`、`webdav_settings_json_bak_ts`（[WebDavStateStore.ets](../entry/src/main/ets/utils/WebDavStateStore.ets:62)）。`initialize` 使用 `preferences.getPreferences`（[同文件](../entry/src/main/ets/utils/WebDavStateStore.ets:120)），读写入口为 `getSettingsJson` / `saveSettingsJson`（[同文件](../entry/src/main/ets/utils/WebDavStateStore.ets:146)）。本次没有直接读取设备 Preferences 文件，也未验证重启持久化。\\r\\n- 真实备份经理入口 `backupToCloudInBackground()` 先检查配置和自身同步状态、预检远端目录，进入内部 `try` 后调用 DBManager（[DataSyncManager.ets](../entry/src/main/ets/sync/DataSyncManager.ets:87)、[导出入口](../entry/src/main/ets/sync/DataSyncManager.ets:140)）。\\r\\n- `@Concurrent executeBackupWithEncrypt` 执行加密和 [WebDavSyncManager.ets](../entry/src/main/ets/sync/WebDavSyncManager.ets:214)。\\r\\n- `WebDavClient` 用 `@ohos.net.http`，构造 Basic Auth，提供 HEAD、GET、PUT 15000/20000ms（[同文件](../entry/src/main/ets/sync/webdav/WebDavClient.ets:139)）。INTERNET 权限已声明（[module.json5](../entry/src/main/module.json5:15)）。\\r\\n\\r\\n`RUNTIME_OBSERVED`：本次应用日志记录导出 0 words、0 user const exportMs = Date.now() - exportStartMs;\r\n      console.info(`[WebDavSyncManager] Export complete data_size=${exportResult.data.length} chars ms=${exportMs}`);\r\n\r\n      // yield 给 UI 线程\r\n @zsw_zhushiwei-->\r\n<!--Adviser: @ge-yafang-->\r\n\r\n\r\nPromise and async/await are standard JavaScript asynchronous syntax, which provides the asynchronous concurrency capability. Asynchronous code is suspended and continues to execute later, ensuring that only one piece of code is executed at any given moment. The following are typical scenarios of asynchronous concurrency:\r\n\r\n- Non-blocking I/O operations: network requests, file reading and writing, and timers.\r\n\r\n- Lightweight tasks without CPU blocking: tasks with short execution times.\r\n\r\n- Clear logical dependencies: tasks with explicit order or parallel relationships.\r\n\r\nAsynchronous concurrency is a feature of programming languages that allows programs to continue executing other asynchronous code without waiting for certain operations to complete.\r\n\r\n## Promise\r\n\r\nA Promise is an object used to process asynchronous operations. It converts asynchronous operations into a style similar to synchronous operations for easier code writing and maintenance. A Promise manages different phases of asynchronous operations through the state mechanism. There are three states for a Promise: pending (in progress), fulfilled (completed, also called resolved), and rejected (failed). After creation, a Promise is in the pending state and transitions to the fulfilled or rejected state upon completion of the asynchronous operation.\r\n\r\nPromise provides the **then**, **catch**, and **finally** methods to register callback functions to handle the success or failure of asynchronous operations. When the Promise status changes, the callback function is added to the microtask queue for execution. The event loop mechanism ensures that microtasks are executed first after macro tasks are executed, thereby ensuring asynchronous scheduling of callback functions.\r\n\r\nThe most basic usage involves instantiating a Promise object through its constructor, passing in a function (usually named **executor**) with two parameters. The two parameters are **resolve** and **reject**, which represent the callback functions for the success and failure of the asynchronous operation, respectively.\r\nFor example, the code snippet below creates a Promise object and simulates an asynchronous operation:\r\n\r\n```ts\r\nconst promise: Promise<number> = new Promise((resolve: Function, reject: Function) => {\r\n  setTimeout(() => {\r\n    const randomNumber: number = Math.random();\r\n    if (randomNumber > 0.5) {\r\n      resolve(randomNumber);\r\n    } else {\r\n      reject(new Error('Random number is too small'));\r\n    }\r\n  }, 1000);\r\n})\r\n```\r\n<!-- @[promise_async_operation](https://gitcode.com/openharmony/applications_app_samples/blob/master/code/DocsSample/ArkTS/ArkTsConcurrent/AsyncConcurrencyOverview/entry/src/main/ets/pages/Index.ets) -->\r\n\r\nIn the above code, the **setTimeout** function simulates an asynchronous operation and generates a random number after 1 second. If the random number is greater than 0.5, the **resolve** callback is invoked with the random number; otherwise, the **reject** callback is invoked with an error object.\r\n\r\nAfter a Promise object is created, you can use the **then** and **catch** methods to specify callback functions for the fulfilled and rejected states. The **then** method can accept two parameters: one for handling the fulfilled state and the other for handling the rejected state. If only one parameter is passed in, the **then** method automatically calls the callback function when the Promise object state changes to **fulfilled**, with the result of the Promise object passed as a parameter. The **catch** method receives a callback function to handle failures, that is, capturing the Promise's transition to the rejected state or any exceptions thrown during the operation. The **finally** method receives a callback function, which will be executed regardless of the Promise's final state (fulfilled or rejected). The code snippet below shows the use of the **then** and **catch** methods.\r\n\r\n```ts\r\nconst promise: Promise<number> = new Promise((resolve: Function, reject: Function) => {\r\n  setTimeout(() => {\r\n    const randomNumber: number = Math.random();\r\n    if (randomNumber > 0.5) {\r\n      resolve(randomNumber);\r\n    } else {\r\n      reject(new Error('Random number is too small'));\r\n    }\r\n  }, 1000);\r\n})\r\n\r\n// Use the then method to define success and failure callbacks.\r\npromise.then((result: number) => {\r\n  console.info(`The number for success is ${result}`); // Executed on success.\r\n}, (error: Error) => {\r\n  console.error(error.message); // Executed on failure.\r\n}\r\n);\r\n\r\n// Use the then method to define a success callback and the catch method to define a failure callback.\r\npromise.then((result: number) => {\r\n  console.info(`Random number is ${result}`); // Executed on success.\r\n}).catch((error: Error) => {\r\n  console.error(error.message); // Executed on failure.\r\n});\r\n\r\n// Executed regardless of success or failure.\r\npromise.finally(() => {\r\n  console.info('finally complete');\r\n})\r\n```\r\n<!-- @[promise_then_catch_handling](https://gitcode.com/openharmony/applications_app_samples/blob/master/code/DocsSample/ArkTS/ArkTsConcurrent/AsyncConcurrencyOverview/entry/src/main/ets/pages/Index.ets) -->\r\n\r\nIn the preceding code, the callback function of the **then** method receives the success result of the Promise object and outputs the result to the console. If the Promise object enters the rejected state, the callback function of the **catch** method receives the error object and outputs the error object to the console.\r\n\r\n> **NOTE**\r\n>\r\n> When a Promise object is rejected and not handled by the **catch** method, it triggers the **globalUnhandledRejectionDetected** event. You can use the [errorManager.on('globalUnhandledRejectionDetected')](../reference/apis-ability-kit/js-apis-app-ability-errorManager.md#errormanageronglobalunhandledrejectiondetected18) API to listen for this event and globally capture unhandled Promise rejects.\r\n\r\n## Async/Await\r\n\r\nAsync/Await is syntactic sugar for handling asynchronous operations with Promises, making it easier and more readable to write asynchronous code. You can use the **async** keyword to declare an asynchronous function and the **await** keyword to wait for the resolution (fulfilled or rejected) of a Promise, and write asynchronous operation code in synchronous mode.\r\n\r\nAn **async** function returns a Promise object to implement an asynchronous operation. It can contain zero or more **await** keywords, pausing execution until the associated Promise completes its state transition (fulfilled/rejected). If an exception is thrown during function execution, the exception directly triggers the returned Promise to enter the rejected state, and the error object can be captured using the **catch** method or the second callback parameter of **then**.\r\n\r\nThe code snippet below uses async/await to simulate an asynchronous operation that returns a string after 3 seconds.\r\n\r\n```ts\r\nasync function myAsyncFunction(): Promise<string> {\r\n  const result: string = await new Promise((resolve: Function) => {\r\n    setTimeout(() => {\r\n      resolve('Hello, world!');\r\n    }, 3000);\r\n  });\r\n  console.info(result); // Output: Hello, world!\r\n  return result;\r\n}\r\n\r\n@Entry\r\n@Component\r\nstruct Index {\r\n  @State message: string = 'Hello World';\r\n  build() {\r\n    Row() {\r\n      Column() {\r\n        Text(this.message)\r\n          .fontSize(50)\r\n          .fontWeight(FontWeight.Bold)\r\n          .onClick(async () => {\r\n            let res = await myAsyncFunction();\r\n            console.info('res is: ' + res);\r\n          })\r\n      }\r\n      .width('100%')\r\n    }\r\n    .height('100%')\r\n  }\r\n}\r\n```\r\n<!-- @[async_await_sync_operation](https://gitcode.com/openharmony/applications_app_samples/blob/master/code/DocsSample/ArkTS/ArkTsConcurrent/AsyncConcurrencyOverview/entry/src/main/ets/pages/Index.ets) -->\r\n\r\nIn the preceding example code, **await** waits for the Promise to resolve and stores the resolved value in the **result** variable.\r\n\r\nSince you need to wait for the completion of the asynchronous operation, the entire operation must be wrapped in an **async** function and used with the **await** keyword. The **await** keyword is valid only in **async** functions. You can also use **try**/**catch** blocks to catch exceptions.\r\n\r\n```ts\r\nasync function myAsyncFunction(): Promise<void> {\r\n  try {\r\n    const result: string = await new Promise((resolve: Function) => {\r\n      resolve('Hello, world!');\r\n    });\r\n    console.info(result); // Output: Hello, world!\r\n  } catch (e) {\r\n    console.error(`Get exception: ${e}`);\r\n  }\r\n}\r\n\r\nmyAsyncFunction();\r\n```\r\n<!-- @[async_operation_error_handling_with_try_catch](https://gitcode.com/openharmony/applications_app_samples/blob/master/code/DocsSample/ArkTS/ArkTsConcurrent/AsyncConcurrencyOverview/entry/src/main/ets/pages/Index.ets) -->\r\nC:/Users/22580/.codex/skills/hmos-arkts-knowledge-retriever/docs/linter/ArkTS_Syntax_Knowledge_From_Linter.md:55:- `catch` 子句中的异常变量是特例。由于 TypeScript 对该位置本身存在约束，linter 不把“省略异常变量类型”当作错误。\r\nC:/Users/22580/.codex/skills/hmos-arkts-knowledge-retriever/docs/linter/ArkTS_Syntax_Knowledge_From_Linter.md:145:- 样例验证：`examples/allow_arrow_function_ok.ets`、`examples/forbid_nested_function_fail.ets`\r\nC:/Users/22580/.codex/skills/hmos-arkts-knowledge-retriever/docs/linter/ArkTS_Syntax_Knowledge_From_Linter.md:406:- `catch` 子句不支持显式异常类型标注。\r\nC:/Users/22580/.codex/skills/hmos-arkts-knowledge-retriever/docs/linter/ArkTS_Syntax_Knowledge_From_Linter.md:878:- `catch` 类型标注\r\nC:/Users/22580/.codex/skills/hmos-arkts-knowledge-retriever/docs/linter/ArkTS_Syntax_Knowledge_From_Linter.md:965:| 语句 | `arkts-no-types-in-catch` | 禁止 `catch` 子句显式类型标注 |\r\nC:/Users/22580/.codex/skills/hmos-arkts-knowledge-retriever/docs/linter/ArkTS_Syntax_Knowledge_From_Linter.md:1000:- 语句：`for...in`、`with`、受限 `throw`、带类型的 `catch`。\r\nC:/Users/22580/.codex/skills/hmos-arkts-knowledge-retriever/docs/linter/ArkTS_Syntax_Knowledge_From_Linter.md:1014:| `examples/allow_arrow_function_ok.ets` | 允许 | `Syntax Check: OK` |\r\nC:/Users/22580/.codex/skills/hmos-arkts-knowledge-retriever/docs/ArkTS-Language-Guide/Basic-Syntax\\advanced-operators.md:5:Operators are part of everyday ArkTS code: arithmetic, comparison, logical conditions, nullish handling, and property access all depend on them. B11–B13、自动同步污染 B26 |\r\n\r\n## 6. 真实 WebDAV 状态机与动作请求表\r\n\r\n### 6.1 明文约束与推导模型\r\n    FinalUI --> UIIdle: 写结果，UI finally busy=false C4\r\n    UIBusy --> UITimedOut: 外层Promise.race达到120000ms C4\r\n    UITimedOut --> UIIdle: UI写异常并finally解除busy\r\n    UITimedOut --> IOStillPossible: 无取消底层Promise的代码\r\n    IOStillPossible --> LateCompletion: 原操作以后才完成，可能有远端副作用\r\n```\r\n\r\n读取此图时必须区分两个时钟：**UI 等待 Promise 已拒绝**，不证明**底层 I/O 已取消**。外层超时后 spinner 是否必须继续显示、能否发起下一轮、晚到成功如何呈现，Spec 未作规定，见 U06；此处只列基线风险。C4 UI finally 不能证明 manager 也始终复位；C7 预检抛错发生在 manager try/finally 外。不得在分析阶段修复，也不得把这些附加风险一律标成官方功能失败。\r\n\r\n基线网络序列：`webdavBackup()` → `backupToCloudInBackground()` → 可选预检 → 本地导出 → 加密任务 → `WebDavClient.put(backupFilePath, ...)` → 真实 `http.request`。PUT 前还可能检查父目录。预检缓存/根目录分支可能无请求；成功上传路径的 PUT 是现有实现事实，**不是把 PUT、HEAD、DELETE 或某个请求数提升为 SPEC_EXPLICIT**。当前按钮不调用 `WebDavBackupManager.backupToCloud()`，不能把那个方法的后续 HEAD 误写进本按钮的必经链路。\r\n\r\n### 6.3 每个相关用户动作是否触发请求\r\n\r\n“新请求”与在途请求分开统计。下表没有把非备份功能扩展为本题新增实现目标。\r\n\r\n| 动作 | 基线静态请求触发 | 本题验收解释 / loading 绑定 |\r\n| --- | --- | --- |\r\n| 进入 WebDAV 分区 | C1/C2/C3 读取配置及自动同步设置，无该按钮的备份请求调用；C13前台事件可能启动自动同步 | 不是备份触发；启动/前台自动同步若发生，需单独归因。仅进入不算 A13。 |\r\n| 填写/修改五个字段 | C3/C5 仅赋值 @Link，无请求 | 不用填字段时的 UI 变化证明备份；本次输入未保存是否生效见 U01。 |\r\n| 点「保存设置」 | C3/C6 设置管理器缓存并保存本地配置，无 WebDAV 请求调用 | 可以作为隔离环境的测试准备，但不得冒充 Spec 明文必经步骤。 |\r\n| 点「测试连接」 | C3 `:320–336` 通过字段校验后，用当前输入调用 `setSettings`（`:334`）更新管理器，再调用 testConnection，可触发真实服务端请求；共用 busy | 会改变随后备份读取的管理器配置，不能与“仅填写后直接备份”混为同一分支；连接测试请求不能充当“立即备份”请求，本题不要求为测试连接新增 spinner。 |\r\n| 点「立即同步」 | C3 `:289–317` 先通过保存方法更新管理器配置，保存返回成功后调用 syncIncremental，共用 busy | 会改变随后备份读取的管理器配置；不是手动备份，保持独立请求窗口，本题不规定增量同步行为。 |\r\n| 空闲时点「立即备份」 | C4/C7/C9：有效配置时进入真实备份链；校验失败可在网络前返回 | 对有效前置必须联合检查 A05、A09、A13、A16；无效前置的错误策略 U03。 |\r\n| busy 中再点备份或快速连点 | C4 guard，C5 disabled；被忽略的调用不会另起备份请求 | 基线倾向拒绝并发；Spec 未明确排队/忽略/并发策略 U05。不能要求每次被禁用点击均发请求。 |\r\n| 首轮真正终结后再点备份 | C4 guard 解除后可重新执行 | D05 用新的请求序号与忙碌窗验证。 |\r\n| 返回设置目录/离开页面 | C2 切分区或 router.back，未见取消备份调用 | 不触发新的手动备份；不能由页面消失推出在途请求已取消。重入策略 U07。 |\r\n| 点备份「取消」/「关闭」 | 本备份流程无此控件；C11/C12 的同名对话框属于其他功能 | 不适用为必经动作；如需新增取消能力须先确认 U06，不能借恢复取消来验收备份。 |\r\n| 关闭/终止应用并重启 | 源码不足以证明设备/进程生命周期及自动同步运行结果 | 不把重启自动备份当作 Spec 需求；终结/恢复策略 U08，实际现象待运行。 |\r\n| 其它操作/自动同步占用经理时点备份 | C7 status 为 SYNCING 时可直接失败；与 UI 本地 busy 是两层状态 | 不能拿其它任务请求当手动备份成功证据；是否排队/报忙 U05。
